newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR HOLDS SUPPORT, TRADE BUY AT LOWS.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE WHITE SUGAR HOLDS SUPPORT, TRADE BUY AT LOWS.

text.p: White sugar futures found good support from trade buyers after a mixed bag of sellers pressured nearby October down to $320 in the early part of Monday's session.
October dominated the thin start to the week as trade, broker and commission house players joined to pummel the contract lower. Technical analysts placed October's next support point at around $315.
"There's been some good selling on the sugar this morning but that's been held fairly well by the trade," said one dealer.
At 1105 GMT October was up 40 cents at $320.50 after reaching an intraday high of $321.20. December was unchanged at $318.50.
Volume totalled 492 lots but around half of this was said to be from crossed trades.
Technical analysts said the outlook for October was turning more bearish although there was still cause for optimism while support held at $315.
"The market is still technically in a bull run while prices hold above the low around $315," said Darren Gurner, analyst at Sucden. "This looks as if prices are moving to test here."
But the outcome of the next few session would give a clearer picture of overall market trend, he added.
The Paris market was quiet with volume amounted to a thin 160 lots. October was down 50 cents at $320.50 and December unchanged at $318.50.
Volume on the lesser-quality 100 ICUMSA market totalled 40 lots and was entirely in March, up 50 cents at $310.50.
